name: Opportunity Engine / External Source Intelligence
purpose: Create verified external source intelligence for universities, TVETs, SETA/QCTO routes, learnerships, bursaries, accommodation, employers, internships, NSFAS, CAO, and private colleges.
locked_doctrine: No fake deadlines.
No fake links.
No fake programme availability.
No fake eligibility claims.
No fake acceptance or placement guarantees.
Every opportunity claim needs source confidence and evidence references.
Official claims require official or authority source confidence.
Stale observations must be marked for review before candidate-facing use.
Private colleges require CHE, DHET, SAQA, or QCTO verification before safe recommendation.
SETA, QCTO, learnership, and employer routes require provider evidence before promotion.
Opportunity intelligence may recommend and route; it must not submit official applications by itself.
Playwright/source scouts observe only and route blocked or uncertain findings to manual review.
All sectors remain open from day one; packages control campaign weight and managed execution count.
Source freshness requires an explicit last-checked timestamp and stale-after boundary; missing freshness evidence fails closed.
Source host matching must use exact registered domains or true subdomains; lookalike domains never qualify as authority.
Duplicate observations are grouped for reconciliation and are not silently deleted; provenance must be preserved.
Deadline claims require evidence and CONFIRMED status; estimated, missing or expired deadlines are not candidate-safe.
Missing eligibility rules remain UNKNOWN; evidence-backed rules still require human review.
Six core pathways are higher education, TVET, SETA/learnerships, internships, apprenticeships, and employment.
Sector routing and match scores are not eligibility determinations or provider-confirmed outcomes.
